_comment: Signal registry for the analog gauge product (ESP32-S3, 320x172 strip, no vehicle bus). Same shape as the MQB registry and consumed by the same tools/gen_catalog.py, minus the acquisition fields: there is no bus to request these over, so no 'requests', 'transform' or 'cycle_time_ms'. How each one is actually measured is core::SensorCal, which is runtime configuration edited from the web form, not something generated at build time. The two products share no signals at all -- an MQB car cannot report oil pressure -- which is why this is a separate registry rather than a filtered view of the other one. display_min/max here are loose fallbacks only: resolve_display_range() prefers SignalConfig::custom_min/max, which is seeded from the fitted sensor's own span when a calibration is saved (see the build plan's 1.2).

signals.name: Oil Pres
signals.notes: Ratiometric transducer on ADS1115 ch0, rail-sense corrected against ch3.

signals.name: Oil Temp
signals.notes: NTC against a pull-up on ADS1115 ch1. Two-wire sender; curve is config.

signals.notes: NTC against a pull-up on ADS1115 ch2. Two-wire sender; curve is config.
